about_the_game:
AI Subtitle Platform Expanding Your Streaming Possibilities

LiveCap is a next-generation AI subtitle generation platform that brings your voice to the world.

With cutting-edge voice recognition technology, your spoken words are instantly converted into accurate subtitles, significantly enhancing viewer immersion. You can stay in your native language and still translate to other language in real-time with just one click, enabling seamless communication with viewers across borders.

Complete integration with OBS enhances your streaming quality dramatically with professional subtitle overlays!

Additionally, the OSC speech bubble feature makes communication in virtual spaces richer and more engaging.

LiveCap also includes functionality to easily generate SRT files from recorded videos, streamlining your post-stream editing workflow.

🚀 Four Innovative Technologies Supporting Professional Streaming

  • Professional Real-time Subtitles: Your spoken words appear as high-precision subtitles within seconds, delivering your content fully to viewers with hearing impairments

    Global Streaming Support: Real-time translation from your native language to other language helps you reach viewers worldwide, building communities beyond language barriers

    Video Editing Workflow Optimization: Generate professional SRT subtitle files from recorded content with one click, significantly reducing subtitle editing time

    Seamless OBS Integration: No complex setup required. Integration between LiveCap and OBS allows you to immediately implement highly visible and customizable subtitle overlays

🌐 Enhanced Communication in Virtual Spaces

  • Real-time Speech Bubbles: Through OSC protocol integration, your words pop up above your avatar in real-time, significantly improving self-expression in virtual spaces

    Communication Revolution: By visualizing speech, the range of communication in virtual spaces expands, enabling smooth interaction even with users speaking different languages

    Enhanced Immersion: When both voice and text are conveyed, your presence in virtual spaces increases, creating deeper roleplay and social experiences

⚠️ System Requirements and Notes

  • Recommended: GPU with 12GB+ VRAM - For optimal performance

    Please try the demo version before purchase - To confirm system compatibility

Take your streaming quality to the next level. Maximize the power of your words with LiveCap!

Try the demo version first to experience these innovative features!

short_description: LiveCap is a subtitle generation platform powered by cutting-edge AI technology. This software delivers accurate, real-time subtitles during live broadcasts. In addition to displaying subtitles in your native language, it is capable of translating them into English in real time.
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
